text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver working results quickly, gather feedback, and improve the product step by step.
